# Mailroom-Corpus-EDA: appendix {.page-title}

[Verification notes · 30 October 2026]{.kicker}

Checked against `Exios66/Mailroom-Corpus-EDA` `5f2252c` on 30 October 2026.

## Counts

310 line-start `def test_` functions in 19 files. `src/` is 11,298 lines of Python across 28 files (`wc -l`). The older "about 200 tests, 185 passed" sentence was an unpinned fresh-environment run and is not the current suite.

## Published revision

The Hub tag in use is v9.2. Changelog v9.3 (17 October 2026) is a staging, label-only revision over the v9.2.1 corporate rows, same 3,302 documents. It was not treated as published.

## Test-share figure

`fig_strata_imbalance_ratio` writes `24_strata_imbalance_ratio.png` with the axis labelled test share percent and a line at 10%. The case-study caption matches that plot. The filename is the part that says imbalance.
